description: Erection of part single-storey, part two-storey side and rear extensions following demolition of existing side extensions; basement enlargement, extending into the existing side and rear lightwells; alterations to the front lightwell including replacement of basement windows with French doors and installation of railings; new side-elevation windows; installation of rooflights at main roof level; replacement of existingsingle-glazed timber sash windows with double-glazed timber sash windows; replacement of the front entrance door; installation of new bargeboards to the front and rear gable ends; together with provision of hard and soft landscaping, bin and cycle stores, and new front boundary wall, railings and gates, in connection with the use of the property as a single dwellinghouse as previously approved under planningpermission ref. 23/P1986.
